The Signature Trip

3 days and 2 nights: Ba Na Hills & Hoi An

The package behind both Christmas deals: a bridge held by giant hands above the clouds, and an ancient town glowing with lanterns. The Hue tour is available as an optional add-on.

  • Hotel Accommodation

    Your Da Nang base for both nights, sorted before you land. No hotel hunting, no guesswork.

  • Ba Na Hills Tour

    Up the cable car through the clouds to walk the Golden Bridge, held high above the forest by two giant stone hands.

  • Hoi An Tour

    The lantern-lit Ancient Town: old merchant houses, the Japanese Covered Bridge, riverside cafes, and streets that glow after dark.

  • Hue Tour · Optional

    Add the Hue tour as an optional extra: the Imperial City and the old capital's royal history, arranged on request.

  • Custom Itineraries

    Want a different route or extra days? Custom itineraries are available at an additional cost.

  • Booked by a Person, Not a Form

    You deal with a real person at HiGo Travel on WhatsApp, from the first question to the day you fly home.

Good to Know

Questions people ask

Quick answers. Anything else, just ask on WhatsApp, a real person replies.

Is the $250 per person?

No, and that is the whole point of Buy 1 Take 1. $250 USD covers two people for the full 3 days and 2 nights package, so it works out to $125 each. The deal is always sold as 2 pax.

We are a group of 3. Which deal fits?

The family deal is priced for 4 ($450, with 2 travelling free). If you are 3, use the booking form on the Deals tab anyway: family deals are available for other group sizes too, and we will price it for you.

What exactly is included?

The main package includes the hotel stay for 2 nights, the Ba Na Hills Tour with the Golden Bridge, and the Hoi An Tour. Message HiGo Travel on WhatsApp for the full rundown for your dates before you book.

Can we add the Hue tour?

Yes. The Hue tour is available as an optional add-on to the main Ba Na Hills and Hoi An package. Tick it in the booking form, or ask on WhatsApp.

Can we change the itinerary?

Yes. Custom itineraries are available at an additional cost. Tell us the sights, days, or route you have in mind and we will build a custom itinerary for your group.

How do I book with a date?

Go to the Deals tab, choose your deal, pick your travel date on the calendar, and set how many are travelling. The WhatsApp button there is already filled in with all of it. Just tap it and press send in WhatsApp.

How is the $300 ProviaMed voucher different?

The voucher is a separate collaboration gift with ProviaMed Diagnostic Clinic in the Philippines, worth $300 USD toward 3 days and 2 nights in Da Nang, valid for travel from December 2026 to February 2027. The Christmas deals are open to everyone, no voucher needed.

Can HiGo book trips beyond Da Nang?

Yes. Da Nang is home base, but HiGo Travel can help beyond Da Nang too. Let us know where you want to go, when, and how many are travelling, and we'll put something together for you.

Our Slogan

Our Vision

To become one of the most trusted and welcoming travel agencies in Da Nang, Vietnam, known for creating unforgettable travel experiences where every guest feels valued, welcomed, and at home.

We envision a travel experience beyond sightseeing, one filled with genuine connections, cultural discoveries, happiness, and beautiful memories that last a lifetime.

No matter where our guests come from, we want them to feel that they are not just visiting a destination, but becoming part of a family.

Our Mission

At HiGo Travel and Tour, our mission is to make every journey special, comfortable, and memorable.

With our passion for travel, international guiding experience, and genuine Filipino hospitality, we aim to provide personalized tours, quality service, affordable travel packages, and authentic local experiences.

We believe every guest deserves to be treated like family, not just another customer.

From the moment they arrive until the time they say goodbye, we want every traveler to feel cared for, appreciated, and at home.

Official Collaboration

HiGo Travel × ProviaMed Diagnostic Clinic

HiGo Travel has teamed up with ProviaMed Diagnostic Clinic in the Philippines for its grand opening. As part of the collaboration, HiGo is giving away a $300 USD gift voucher toward a Da Nang escape: 3 days and 2 nights, on us.

  • ProviaMed Grand Opening: November 18, 2026, now DOH licensed in the Philippines
  • Opening treat at the clinic: free blood typing and glucose test for the first 30 patients
  • Voucher: $300 USD toward 3 days and 2 nights in Da Nang
  • Travel window: December 2026 to February 2027
  • To claim, pick the voucher in the booking form on the Deals tab and present the voucher when you book

The actual collaboration voucher: HiGo Travel × ProviaMed Diagnostic Clinic. Voucher is non-refundable and non-exchangeable for cash; booking subject to availability.
